# Supported agents

<!-- generated by scripts/generate-agents.mjs - do not edit -->

The 74 agents `KaizenTicketing.SkillEmbed` knows, generated from the agent table of [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) 1.8.1 (`e781cb4`).

The paths are the defaults on Linux. Where an agent has an environment variable for its directory, such as `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, the variable wins; some paths differ on macOS and Windows. `src/KaizenTicketing.SkillEmbed/Agents/agents.json` has every alternative.

## Agents left out

These are in the upstream table, and a single test for a path cannot describe them. Add one in your own code with `new SkillAgent(...)`.

| Name | Agent | Why |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `eve` | Eve | It has no skills directory at user level. |
| `replit` | Replit | Nothing at user level shows that it is installed. |
| `zed` | Zed | Its detection is more than a test for a path. |
| `promptscript` | PromptScript | Nothing at user level shows that it is installed. |
